compute_td_lambda_return: compute the td-lambda return of a path given rewards, gamma, td_lambda, and value estimates
compute_rl_return_with_discount: compute discounted returns for a reinforcement learning trajectory using temporal difference lambda
calculate_path_returns: calculate the return values for each timestep in a reward sequence using TD-lambda backup
run_compute_return: run compute_return to get TD-lambda returns from a list of rewards and value function estimates
test_compute_return: test the compute_return function with sample rewards, discount factor, lambda parameter, and value estimates
